page.notes: The mark "·" after "nibus." and the small mark under "ad" in the body look like printer's or stray marks, not text, and are left out. The word "es-set" at the line break (line 1) is uncertain: the long s in the hyphenated part may be read differently. The word "obscuritatē" carries a tilde-like mark over the e, transcribed as printed. The heading "QVALE SIT COELVM?" is set in capitals as a part of the chapter, so level 2 is used.
